messages.author: 8afbd632a3ffa2dd
messages.subject: extracting and labeling subsets of data
parts:
I have a datafile. I also have several other datafiles consisting of
subsets of the first datafile.

example

Datafile A consists of several rows of
Label, Control (X), Tacky (Y)

Datafile B (a subset) consists of
Label

Datafile C (a subset) consists of
Label

I need a way to use Datafiles B and C to extract only matching entries
from Datafile A and graph them as a scatterplot with different colors
for different subsets.


valuefile <- read.csv(file.choose())
valuefileB<-read.csv(file.choose())
valuefileC<-read.csv(file.choose())
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
df = data.frame(Control =valuefile$value_Control, tacky=valuefile
$value_tacky, valuelab=valuefile$labelcol)


plot1<-ggplot(data=df, aes(x=Control, y=tacky, colour=subset )) +
geom_point() + geom_text(size=2,aes(label=valuelab)) +
geom_smooth(method="lm")






If need be I can alter the subset files manually to make a potential
solution easier such as maybe adding a subset value column to each
subset file.

thanks

More a general R problem. See ?merge

Bmerge <- merge(valuefile, valuefileB, by="Label")

> library(ggplot2)
> library(grid)

I'm confused as to why you've made another dataframe here. See
?colnames if you are just trying to change the names.

Is this about right?

ggplot(valuefile, aes(x=Control, y=Tacky)) +
geom_point(alpha=0.4) +
geom_point(data=Bmerge, aes(x=Control, y=Tacky), col='red')

There are undoubtedly more elegant ways of doing this but this should
work if I understand your problem.

HTH,

Sam
